title: Mrs. Amreen Saba
content:
Mrs. Amreen Saba

Assistant Professor

Education Details

  • M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, PES College of Engineering, Mysuru, VTU.
  • B.E in ISE GSSS Institute of Engineering and technology for women, Mysuru, VTU.

Professional Experience

  • Teaching Experience – 4 years
  • Assistant Professor, Cresta school of management science and Arts, Mysuru,  June 2019 – June 2023.

Publication Details

International Journals:

  1. Amreen Saba, Dr.Nagarathna published paper titled “Comparative analysis on DCT and SVD for Efficient Image Compression” in Journal of Emerging Technologies and Innovative Research (JETIR),  Volume 5, Issue 6, June-2018, eISSN: 2349-5162.
  2. Amreen Saba, Dr.Nagarathna presented paper titled “"IOT Based Energy Efficient Security System"at iCATccT August 2016 at SIT, Tumkur, published in IEEE Xplore, 2017.
  3. Amreen Saba, Asfiya Muhammadi Basheer, published paper titled “Wireless Manoeuvre Control of Fire Bird V Robot Using ZigBee Communication” in International Journal of Innovative Research in Science, Engineering and Technology (IJIRSET), Volume 5, Issue 4, April-2016, ISSN(Online) : 2319-8753
